_meta.title: SB01 — Cut List: 10ft Hex Cedar Gazebo
_meta.project: Saanich BC | Traditional M+T | No metal hangers
_meta.note: All lengths are CUT lengths. Add 10% waste factor when ordering. Saw compound cuts on scrap first.

members.notes: Seal end grain with epoxy; orient heartwood out
Miter cuts are opposing (parallelogram) — mark crown side up

members.cut_type: Compound: miter=28.71° bevel=9.10° at top; plumb bevel-only cut at tail
members.notes: Total raw length ~6'-6". Bird's mouth at beam; tenon at hub end. See Detail 1, SB-04.

members.cut_type: Square both ends; 6× compound-angle mortises at 60°
members.notes: Hand-chop mortises after layout on mill. Dry-fit all 6 rafters before glue-up.
2 per post (one to beam each side). Tenon 1.5"×3" each end. Grain direction: diagonal.
Sits mid-span between hub and beam. Half-lap or M+T to rafter. Check fit in field.

oak_drawbore_pegs.notes: 2 per rafter-hub joint (6 rafters), 2 per post-beam joint (6 posts), 2 per brace pair × 12 braces

j_bolts.notes: One per caisson; set in wet concrete; Saanich seismic zone 4 — verify hold-down with engineer

post_bases.type: Simpson E66 or equivalent standoff post base
post_bases.notes: Standoff required — no post-in-ground for cedar longevity

exterior_glue.type: Titebond III or System Three T-88 epoxy
exterior_glue.notes: Use sparingly on tenon shoulders only — do not flood mortise
